title: Filter a dashboard by a label

blocks.content: Dashboard filters narrow every panel to the series that match a label. In this guide you add a `job` filter, watch the graph update, and then remove it.

blocks.tooltip: This demo dashboard has a filter variable with group by turned on.

blocks.content: To add a filter, choose a label, an operator, and a value:
Add a **job** filter: in the **Filters** box, type `job`, choose **=**, and then choose the first job value. Select **Run 2 steps** to have Pathfinder do them in order.

steps.tooltip: Every Prometheus target has a job label.

steps.description: Choose a value. This step picks the first job in the list.
steps.tooltip: Type to search when the list is long.

blocks.content: Your filter is now a pill. Every panel that queries this data source now includes the `job` filter, so the graph shows only requests for that job.
blocks.tooltip: Click the pill to change its operator or value.

blocks.content: You added a filter that applies to every matching panel on the dashboard.
Remove the **job** filter to bring back every job.
blocks.tooltip: Clear all removes every filter at once.

blocks.content: You removed the filter, and the graph shows every job again. Filters are stored in the URL, so you can share a filtered view by sharing the link.
